user_confirmations: Use normal concrete fc' 320 ksc and exclude prestress in the first study only; compare t=150/175/200mm, not final material/prestress selection.
LP-A: wall-roof halves transfer directly to independently designed supports; floor remains separate.

material.E_source: EIT-011008-21 clause 8.5.1, printed page 55, PDF page 67; general density-dependent SI expression

roof_load_mapping: vertical on outer horizontal projection; equivalent nodal forces and My couples preserve exact force and first moment
self_weight_mapping: exact straight/annular-sector volume and centroid; equivalent nodal forces and My couples preserve force and first moment

joints.meaning: three-hinge in-plane limit; not hardware selection
fixed bases, crown rotation Ry released

base_dof.PIN_LINE: Ux=Uz=0 along both wall base lines; Uy=0 only at Y=L/2 on each base; rotations free
base_dof.FIXED_LINE: Ux=Uz=Rx=Ry=Rz=0 along both wall base lines; Uy=0 only at Y=L/2 on each base

crown_dof.HINGE_Y: duplicate coincident LH/RH nodes; equal Ux,Uy,Uz,Rx,Rz; relative Ry free
crown_dof.RIGID: duplicate coincident LH/RH nodes; all six DOF equal

bay_end_edges: Y=0,L free; no assumed ties to adjacent bays; not full-building stability

refinement_followup.reason: M2/M3 interior Nsy/Msy/Qy did not meet the original 5% criterion; keep criterion unchanged

qa_criteria_set_before_run.scope: research QA targets, not structural acceptance or code limits

mandatory_limitations: high t/Rm: solid/continuum comparison not done
no openings, foundations, adjacent bays, L/U nodes, drainage slope or finishes
